play.core_loop: 官方Google Play描述为房间整理谜题：查看箱子标签，点选对应物件装箱；没有匹配箱子的物品进入有限暂存槽，玩家安排收集顺序完成房间，获取星星并可重玩改善用时。
highlights: 设计分析：装箱完成会释放空间，形成可预期的清理反馈。
设计分析：有限暂存区让快速点击与计划顺序之间形成取舍。
innovations: 把目标箱子和房间找物结合；未发现可证实的独创基础规则，应按成熟机制组合评估。

clone.rationale: 可研究暂存槽与目标箱的反馈，直接同题材竞争差异较小。应先测试原创订单变化是否产生额外可理解的决策。
suggestions: 用三个目标箱和两种暂存上限制作对照关卡。
将星级用时目标改为原创的打包优先级，观察是否增加计划感。
risks: 多语言标签与物件图形可能导致识别误差。
奖励广告扩槽的收益与关卡公平性需要分别验证。
clone.effort: 推断：单房间箱子整理原型12–20人日，多场景资产另计。

media.description:
In Amochiroom Puzzle: Room Sort, turn everyday clutter into a satisfying sorting puzzle.

Explore cozy rooms, find the items your boxes need, and tap matching objects to pack them away. Read each box label and choose what to collect next. Items without a matching box wait in limited temporary slots, so a little planning helps you keep making space.

Find it. Sort it.
Look through piles of familiar objects and match them to the right boxes. Decide which items to collect first as you work through each room.

A place for your next move
Keep an eye on your temporary slots. Make thoughtful choices before they fill up, and clear space for the next objects.

Rooms with their own character
Discover living rooms, kitchens, pet corners, cafés, and other themed spaces filled with everyday things to sort.

Enjoy the tidy finish
Complete puzzles, earn stars, and revisit earlier rooms to improve your best times.

Play your way
Choose from multiple interface languages and adjust music, sound effects, and vibration. Your progress is saved on your device, and no account registration is required.

Amochiroom Puzzle is free to play and contains ads. Optional rewarded ads can provide extra space, helpful tools, or energy; interstitial ads may appear between levels. Ads and optional feedback require an internet connection.
